shared_elements: horizontal linear band with repeated short strokes or notches
justification: The most specific correspondence is the use of long horizontal elements carrying repeated short perpendicular marks, visible as a patterned carved band in A and as notched linear forms in B. The biggest difference is that A is a densely filled carved relief with varied figurative motifs on an upright block, while B is a sparse red linear painting dominated by a few boat-like forms on a flat rock surface.
